classifiedFinding.title: pauseWithdraw silently forfeits accrued rewards with no event and orphans per-share-accumulator residue

classification.assetImpact: Bare forfeiture: user loses accrued rewards on the withdrawn portion (KI-4 acknowledges this). Orphaned per-share accumulator residue lingers with no defined redistribution — value leak.
attackPath: 3. user.amount and totalStaked decrement; rewardBalance unchanged; user.debt unchanged.
4. accStablePerShare implicitly enriches future entrants (or sits as dead weight).
classification.likelihood: high — every pauseWithdraw call triggers this

classifiedFinding.justification: Per the sanitizer flag: the bare 'forfeit accrued rewards' aspect IS KI-4. The downstream debt-staleness DoS is fully captured by DEDUP-002 (Medium). What remains in this finding is (a) missing RewardsForfeited event for off-chain reconciliation and (b) orphan-accumulator redistribution semantics. Both are spec/observability defects, not value-at-risk findings. Demote to Low/QA per the sanitizer's note that downstream effects are already captured elsewhere.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer flagged for review. Classifier routes to Low/QA: the unique angle (missing event + orphan-residue semantics) is QA-grade; the downstream DoS is captured by DEDUP-002. Avoids double-counting.
